workItem: Implement a read-only automated consistency validator for the canonical Project Value Chain and project-folder routing, reusing existing Governance/CI paths without creating a parallel authority plane.
workItemDE: Eine read-only automatisierte Konsistenzprüfung für die kanonische Project Value Chain und die Projektordner-Zuordnung implementieren und dabei bestehende Governance-/CI-Pfade wiederverwenden, ohne eine parallele Authority-Ebene zu erzeugen.
ownerRole: Organizational project architecture and Governance execution coordination; no foreign productive PVC implementation
foreignWork: No foreign project content is rewritten. Existing CLIENT VC-01 transitional wording is explicitly tolerated only while the canonical PROJECT_VALUE_CHAIN transitional exception remains present.
authorityGuard: The validator enforces internal consistency of already-declared project/PVC mappings. It creates no AUTH/CTRL/ADR/ESS identity, does not turn project roadmaps into authorization authority, grants no productive PVC ownership, and performs no merge, deployment or external mutation. In the Governance workflow only trusted-main validator code may execute against candidate project metadata.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, close, supersession or abandonment. PR creation remains exact Base/Head snapshot Human/Owner-gated; merge remains Human/CODEOWNER-only.
